response.justification: While Bogdan is a highly accomplished software engineer with 20 years of experience and demonstrated expertise in performance optimization, this Principal Performance Architect role requires specialized hardware-level expertise that is entirely absent from his background. The position specifically demands SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture analysis, and deep learning workload optimization—domains where he has no demonstrated experience. His career has been exclusively in software development rather than hardware architecture. Although recent AI infrastructure work at re:cinq shows adaptability, the fundamental gap in hardware expertise makes him unsuitable for this principal-level hardware-focused role.
strengths: 20+ years of software engineering with demonstrated performance optimization expertise across multiple domains
Multiple Staff-level IC positions showing technical depth and leadership capability
Recent AI infrastructure exposure and proven ability to rapidly master new technologies
concerns: No experience with SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, or hardware-level design—core job responsibilities
Lacks deep learning workload optimization and neural network inference expertise required for the role
Career entirely in software development; no hardware-software co-design or hardware architecture background
